ComicInfo.Title: Live Capture
ComicInfo.Summary: PLANETFALL! A deadly cadre of warriors pursue their target to Earth, a target making a beeline to the X-Men's home territory of Alaska! But who is this fugitive, and what grim portents do they carry for the X-Men?
